name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: HBD tooltip: a floating label shown on hover (after the --hbd-tooltip-delay-show delay) / focus (instant), built on Radix Tooltip with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied to the Content panel (className via asChild) so the de-shadowed tooltip.css renders 1:1, including the CSS-triangle arrow (.hbd-tooltip__arrow driven by --hbd-tooltip-arrow-size) and placement top|bottom|left|right with collision flip + shift (the WC's opposite-side flip + viewport clamp). role=tooltip on the panel with aria-describedby wired trigger->panel; aria-live=off; Escape + pointer-down dismiss keeping trigger focus. Token-driven show delay via the --hbd-tooltip-delay-show token (overridable with the legacy `delay` prop); a `content` convenience prop or compound Tooltip.Trigger / Tooltip.Content members. Controlled-first overlay via open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen.
